markets.question: Will Harambee Stars win at least one group-stage match at AFCON 2027?
markets.resolution_criteria: Answer YES if Kenya wins at least one of its group-stage matches at the AFCON 2027 final tournament (a win in 90 minutes plus stoppage time, or an awarded win); otherwise NO once Kenya's group matches are complete. The final tournament uses the CAF-published format (24 teams; group winners, runners-up and the four best third-placed teams advance to the round of 16). Reaching a round means playing in it; a win after extra time or on penalties counts as advancing. A match awarded by CAF counts with its awarded result. Qualifiers do not count. If the event is cancelled or not completed by 2027-08-16 23:59 EAT, the market is void and stakes are refunded. Results are final when the official source publishes them; a change (appeal, disqualification, reclassification) is applied only if the official source publishes it within 7 days of the event, after which the market stays settled.
